up: Retrieve approved drugs indicated for lymphoma. Return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, and indication details (mesh_heading and efo_term). Filter for molecules with max_phase = 4. The indication must contain the term 'lymphoma' (case-insensitive) in either mesh_heading or efo_term. Join molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and drug_indication. Return distinct rows for each drug-indication pair.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%lymphoma%' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%lymphoma%')
